blocks.text: In epidemiology, biostatistics is used to investigate the distribution and determinants of diseases within populations. It helps public health experts understand how diseases spread, identify risk factors, and evaluate the impact of preventive measures. By modelling disease trends and assessing intervention outcomes, biostatistics supports efforts to control epidemics and improve community health.
